name: button
summary: A control a person presses to do one thing, such as Add to list or Place order.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The words on it, which are also its spoken name. With an action, the action's label.

properties.name: action
properties.description: The defineAction it runs. Its label, description and id become the button's words, hint and automation id, and a press goes through the person's door.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: The colour role, from the theme: primary reads colors.primary.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual weight: solid fills with the tone, soft tints, outline draws the edge, plain draws text only.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Height. Every size keeps a 44-point target on touch.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Can't be pressed, and says so to assistive technology.

properties.name: busy
properties.description: Its action is running: it keeps its width, can't be pressed again, and tells assistive technology it is busy.

events.name: press
events.description: A person pressed it: a click, a tap, Enter or Space while focused, or an accessibility Invoke.

states.name: hover
states.description: A pointer over it: the fill a step stronger.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Held down: scales to the press scale token (0.97), not at all when the platform's reduce-motion setting is on.

states.name: focused
states.description: Keyboard focus: the platform's own focus ring, never removed.

states.name: busy
states.description: A spinner in place of the words, same width.

accessibility.name: Its words, or the action's label.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab focuses it; Enter and Space press it.
accessibility.web: <button> (or <a> with href), named by its text; aria-busy while busy.
accessibility.apple: A SwiftUI Button (Button(intent:) with an action), with the button trait.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Button with the Invoke pattern, named by its words; AutomationId action.<id> with an action.

cases.person: A filled primary button that says Add to list.
A tinted button that says Place order.
An outlined red button that says Delete list.

deviations: Also a link with href, and an inline size that takes the text's size; the native kits have no links in their buttons.
Adds a glass variant (Liquid Glass) and a pill or rounded shape; neither exists on other platforms yet.
